purpose_context: Every Hubnot merge waits for a maintainer today, because automerge still requires per-proposal maintainer acceptances and its executors must be maintainers. This mission adds an opt-in rule mode whose standing acceptance is the signed policy amendment that adopted it. A non-maintainer executor can then merge proposals that satisfy the rule, every client and hn serve re-derive and verify that the rule was satisfied, and maintainers keep approving policy amendments and protected-check changes by hand.
purpose_tldr: Let one maintainer-accepted policy amendment adopt an automerge rule that stands in for per-proposal maintainer acceptance, so a non-maintainer executor can merge eligible ordinary changes.
